text: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France, located along the Seine river in the north of the country.
Mount Everest, located in the Himalayas on the border of Nepal and Tibet, is the highest mountain above sea level on Earth.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.
The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, describes how space and time are linked for objects moving at a consistent speed in a straight line.
A neural network is a computing system inspired by biological brains, made up of layers of interconnected nodes that learn patterns from data.
Cloud computing allows users to access computing resources such as servers, storage, and databases over the internet rather than owning physical hardware.
The printing press, invented by Johannes Gutenberg in the 15th century, revolutionized the spread of information across Europe.
The Silk Road was a network of trade routes connecting the East and West, facilitating the exchange of goods, ideas, and culture for centuries.
Sourdough bread gets its distinctive tangy flavor from a fermented starter made of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria.
Sushi is a traditional Japanese dish that typically combines vinegared rice with seafood, vegetables, and sometimes tropical fruits.
